data.name: ReGenerate Livermore Falls
data.description: ReGenerate Livermore Falls, LLC is a 39 MW biomass power facility in Livermore Falls, Maine, owned by ReGenerate Energy Holdings (a JV of Ember Infrastructure and ReEnergy Biomass Operations). The plant's primary business is selling baseload renewable electricity (under a 20-year PPA with Central Maine Power); biochar is produced as a byproduct of the gasification process and certified under Puro.earth's Biochar 2022 methodology, with 7,316 CORCs issued as of the latest listing.
